description: The prosthetic-conscience rule hooks, each behind the bootstrap guard; why each is wired this way is in hooks/README.md.

hooks.command: B="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/bin/sc-pretooluse"; if [ -x "$B" ] || [ -x "$B.exe" ]; then exec "$B"; fi; F="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/fetch-bin.sh"; if [ -f "$F" ]; then exec sh "$F" hook PreToolUse; fi; echo 'prosthetic-conscience: hook binaries missing — run /prosthetic-conscience:doctor --fix' >&2
